mathematical_review.spectator_coordinates: Physical coordinates are ((X,Y),Z); enlarged coordinates are (((s,e),(X,Y)),Z). Physical lifting uses the reassociation to ((s,e),((X,Y),Z)), fixes both ancillas and retains Z. Copying reads the original X coordinate from e and inserts the s and X blanks.
